# Proxy-variable analysis

This document is a separate workspace for developing the proxy-variable
analysis. It is not sourced by `study_1_sensitivity.qmd` and therefore does not
affect the completed sensitivity analyses or their render.

The initial implementation is restricted to a genuinely binary focal
predictor, $X$. The remaining variables in the adjustment set are denoted by
$Z$, and $U$ is a continuous latent proxy with unit variance. We fit

$$
\Pr(X=1\mid Z)=\Phi\{f_X(Z)\},
$$

$$
U\mid X,Z \sim \operatorname{BART},
\qquad \operatorname{Var}(U)=1,
$$

and

$$
\Pr(Y=1\mid X,U)=\Phi\{f_Y(X,U)\}.
$$

Probit BART estimates $f_X$ and $f_Y$, and Gaussian BART estimates $f_U$.
During model fitting, $U$ is updated conditional on each participant's observed
$X$ and $Z$.

## Counterfactual risks

For a contrast of $x$ with $x'$, define four conditional expectations:

$$
M_{x\mid x}(z)
=E[E(Y\mid X=x,U)\mid X=x,Z=z],
$$

$$
M_{x\mid x'}(z)
=E[E(Y\mid X=x,U)\mid X=x',Z=z],
$$

$$
M_{x'\mid x}(z)
=E[E(Y\mid X=x',U)\mid X=x,Z=z],
$$

and

$$
M_{x'\mid x'}(z)
=E[E(Y\mid X=x',U)\mid X=x',Z=z].
$$

Let

$$
\pi_x(z)=\Pr(X=x\mid Z=z),
\qquad
\pi_{x'}(z)=1-\pi_x(z).
$$

The two counterfactual outcome risks conditional on $Z$ are

$$
E\{Y(x)\mid Z=z\}
=\pi_x(z)M_{x\mid x}(z)
+\pi_{x'}(z)M_{x\mid x'}(z)
$$

and

$$
E\{Y(x')\mid Z=z\}
=\pi_x(z)M_{x'\mid x}(z)
+\pi_{x'}(z)M_{x'\mid x'}(z).
$$

Each $M$ term is integrated over draws from the corresponding fitted
$U\mid X,Z$ distribution. The resulting two risks enter the same population
relative-risk calculation used in the primary analysis.

## Code setup

```{r}
source("R/imports.R")

set.seed(20260322)
```

The joint BART Gibbs sampler will be added and reviewed here before a proxy
model is run. Continuous and multi-level categorical focal predictors are
outside the scope of the initial implementation.
